name: Harborside Armory
description: A national guard depot with rusting fences and a night crew that plays cards.

name: Southern Cross Airfield
description: A gravel strip in the outback where transport crews refuel, sleep off the heat, and log almost nothing.

name: Fort Bastion Motor Pool
description: Armored columns fuel here before every parade — and every crackdown.

name: Skywatch Radar Station
description: A mountaintop dish array that tracks everything in low orbit. Everything.

name: The Citadel — Strategic Command
description: The alliance's hardened war room. Interceptors launch on its word alone.

name: City Hall Annex
description: Permits, zoning, and the first rung of every ladder worth corrupting.

name: Provincial Records Bureau
description: Land deeds, census rolls, and a new identity for anyone whose paperwork is thick enough.

name: The Grand Embassy
description: Chandeliers, diplomatic pouches, and secrets traded over sparkling wine.

name: Global Broadcasting House
description: The feed the whole world trusts, uplinked from one very bribable tower.

name: World Assembly Hall
description: Every flag on Earth under one glass dome. The podium hears everything first.

name: Dockside Freeport
description: Bonded warehouses where cargo changes owners faster than paperwork.

name: Sunstone Gem Exchange
description: Rough stones cross this floor uncut, untaxed, and untraceable by closing bell.

name: Gilded Lotus Casino
description: High rollers, higher stakes, and a vault that launders three currencies a night.

name: AeroDyne Aerospace Campus
description: Private launch contractor with orbital lift capacity and lax shareholder oversight.

name: Meridian World Bank
description: The clearing house for half the planet's money. The other half wishes it was.
